description: This file defines the DroppingStream class which implements the StreamInterface as a decorator around another stream, with functionality to start dropping data once the stream exceeds a specified maximum length.

classes.name: DroppingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that drops data when the underlying stream exceeds a maximum length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DroppingStream with an underlying stream and a maximum length to control data dropping.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying stream, but drops data if the stream is already too full.
